evidence.result: rewards are real, but even the low tier requires a previously unknown security impact rather than ordinary bug fixing
testing must use owned accounts and avoid other-user impact, spam, excessive automation, PII access, and public disclosure
reports must be original and previously unreported; invalid submissions can reduce eligibility
client rewards generally require reproducible unauthorized action, restricted-information access, or mitigation bypass

latest_market_scan.decision: Do not turn the hourly revenue automation into speculative security testing. Preserve the path but prefer paid issues after cooldown and demand-first product publication when credentials become available.
